tc853_rationale: Re-recorded by TC-853 (G3), 2026-11-20, under operator decision DG-1: parse_failure_undercount:tex__python is REMOVED because it is fixed, not weakened. tex/python is re-pinned at the upstream release 26.11.1 (07db3203), where all 59 source files parse as written (ast.parse and py_compile, re-measured in a clean clone), so the regenerated fixture reports parse_failures failed 0 of 59, exposes no as_written_failed field (the extractor writes it only when nonzero) and the baked generation's API-Coverage line no longer carries 'could not be parsed'. The 11 Python pilots now all report zero parse failures. The alias_duplication:tex__python entry is left exactly as it was (tex/python has been at or below the duplicate threshold since TC-775, so it is not observed; this card does not touch it); strict stays false.
